title: Slow it down: AI writes one token at a time

beats.say: Slow it down and everything happens one frame at a time. AI works the same way. It writes one token at a time.
A token is a small chunk of text. In English it's roughly four characters, about three quarters of a word.
The model reads your whole prompt, picks the most likely next token, adds it, and then does it all again.
That's why your prompt matters so much. Every word you write shapes every token that comes after.

prompt: Rewrite the prompt I'm about to paste so it is specific, includes one example of the output I want, and says what to avoid. Show me the before and after, and explain in one line each why every change makes the answer better.
caption: Slow motion breaks things into frames. AI breaks writing into tokens: it reads your whole prompt, picks the most likely next token, adds it, and repeats. A token is roughly 4 characters of English, about 3/4 of a word. That's why a specific prompt with an example and clear limits steers every token that follows. The prompt is at the end. Building your own app? Use code AT100 on Base44 (link in bio).
